hero.description: A leadership and financial education platform empowering individuals, families, and entrepreneurs through financial literacy, mentorship, and leadership development.

detail.overviewDesc: Power Mindset Breakthrough delivers coaching programmes at scale. We built a platform that presents the methodology, handles session booking and distributes programme content to enrolled clients.
detail.challengeDesc: Coaching delivery was spread across scheduling tools, email and file shares, which capped how many clients the programme could serve without adding admin.
detail.builtDesc: We built a single platform that presents the methodology, handles session booking and distributes programme content to enrolled clients, with access tied to enrolment.

items.title: Programme content delivery to enrolled clients

outcomes: Booking and content delivery live in one place
Admin no longer scales linearly with client count
Clients get a consistent programme experience
